exposure: total deceleration area (TDA) on intrapartum cardiotocogram
outcome: cord blood pH obtained at delivery
cohort: The study included 168 women in labor experiencing intrapartum fetal distress (category III or persistent category II on cardiotocogram) who had 30-minute CTG traces prior to delivery and umbilical cord blood gas analysis at delivery.
finding: An intrapartum TDA of >= 195 missed beats was significantly associated with neonatal acidemia at birth, with a positive predictive value of 83.78%.
cross-section timing: Intrapartum (last 30 minutes before delivery) and at delivery
